metadata.issueBody:
Parent: #3940

## Finding

The always-on managed card cites ADR-003, and docs/decisions/ is absent from the packed deposit, so the consumer is sent to a decision record the install does not contain.

Split out of #3940 so the parent stays a tracker and this failure can be triaged on its own. A fix for the other findings on that report would not close this one.

## Normalization

- Promise: CONTINUITY
- Priority: High (audit scale S2)
- Source: #3940
